logline: A grandmother always sets out one coffee cup too many, until the night we learn who it is for.
audience: Young Ethiopians living away from home, and the relatives who would send them this film
intent: Feel that home is a habit of welcome you can carry with you, and want to call someone
style_block: Hand-painted gouache illustration, visible brush texture, soft film grain, warm amber and terracotta palette with deep indigo shadows, gentle firelight, quiet and intimate, subject centred in frame, full-bleed painting reaching every edge

people.statement: All characters are invented. The narrator is a stock synthetic voice.

am.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

en.style: warm, calm and unhurried, like telling a family story at night

grandmother.prompt: Character portrait of an invented elderly Ethiopian highland grandmother, kind lined face, deep brown skin, silver hair under a plain white cotton netela shawl with a narrow green and gold woven border, long white handwoven cotton dress, small plain round silver stud earrings, facing the viewer, gentle closed-mouth smile, plain warm background, upper body
grandmother.reason: Provisional agent choice, awaiting applicant approval: distinct shawl border, plain earrings, full-bleed

coffee_set.prompt: Still life of a traditional Ethiopian coffee set. A jebena: a matte black clay bottle with a round ball-shaped base and one tall slender vertical tube neck like a narrow bottle, a small woven straw stopper in the top of the neck, a curved clay loop handle joining neck and base. Beside it four small white porcelain bowl-shaped cups, smooth round sides, thin green rim, on a low dark wooden tray. Fresh green grass on an earthen floor, soft firelight from the side
coffee_set.reason: Provisional agent choice, awaiting applicant approval: long-necked jebena, four handleless cups, full-bleed

video.negative_prompt: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, morphing, flicker, fast motion, camera shake, blurry, low quality

music.caption: Instrumental, intimate Ethiopian highland mood, solo krar lyre plucked gently, soft washint flute answering far away, warm low drone, sparse and tender, pentatonic, acoustic, close room sound, no drums, no vocals

cues.note: A few plucked notes before the voice
Near silence for the knock at the door
The opening notes return, then fade on the end card

shots.reason: Establishes place, dusk and warmth before any person appears
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a small round Ethiopian highland house with a thatched roof at dusk, warm light in the open doorway, thin smoke rising, green hills and heavy rain clouds behind
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke drifts slowly upward, grass moves in a soft wind, the camera pushes in very gently

narration.am: አያቴ ቡና ስታፈላ፣ ሁልጊዜ አንድ ትርፍ ሲኒ ታስቀምጥ ነበር።
narration.en: Whenever my grandmother made coffee, she always set out one extra cup.

shots.reason: Introduces the cup, the object that returns through the film
shots.image_prompt: View from above of a low dark wooden tray on an earthen floor with green grass: three small white bowl-shaped cups with a thin green rim in a close group, and one more identical cup standing apart on its own at the edge of the tray, warm firelight
shots.motion_prompt: Firelight flickers softly on the cups, the camera slides slowly sideways

narration.am: ሦስት ሰዎች ብንሆን፣ አራት ሲኒ። አራት ብንሆን፣ አምስት።
narration.en: If we were three, four cups. If we were four, five.

shots.reason: Meets the grandmother in action, at the centre of her home
shots.image_prompt: The same grandmother from the reference, in her white shawl with green and gold border, seated on a low stool, pouring coffee from the black clay jebena bottle with tall slender neck into a small white cup, dim warm room
shots.motion_prompt: A thin stream of coffee pours steadily, steam rises, the camera is fixed

narration.en: “Grandmother, whose is this one?” I asked her.

shots.reason: Her face carries the answer, the idea the film turns on
shots.image_prompt: Tight close-up of the face of the same grandmother from the reference filling the frame, white shawl with green and gold border around her head, looking up with a gentle knowing smile, firelight on one side of her face, dark room behind
shots.motion_prompt: She smiles softly and blinks once, firelight flickers, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ፈገግ ብላ፣ «መንገድ ላይ ላለው ሰው ነው» አለችኝ።
narration.en: She smiled and said, “It is for the one still on the road.”

shots.reason: The empty cup makes us wait with the child
shots.image_prompt: One single small white bowl-shaped cup like a tiny porcelain bowl, smooth round sides, thin green rim, empty, alone on a low dark wooden tray, morning light from a small window, dust in the air
shots.motion_prompt: Dust drifts slowly through the light, the camera pulls back very gently

narration.am: ለብዙ ዓመታት፣ ያ ሲኒ ባዶውን ይቀመጥ ነበር።
narration.en: For many years, that cup sat empty.

shots.reason: The turn: something arrives from outside
shots.image_prompt: Inside a dark earthen highland house at night, looking at a closed rough wooden plank door, thin lines of cold blue light glowing between the planks and under the door, warm firelight on the earthen floor and walls
shots.motion_prompt: Rain falls outside, firelight trembles on the door, the camera pushes in slowly

narration.am: አንድ ዝናባማ ምሽት ግን፣ በሩ ተንኳኳ።
narration.en: But one rainy evening, there was a knock at the door.

shots.reason: The promise is kept; hands keep it about the gesture, not the stranger's face
shots.image_prompt: Close view of two pairs of hands, an elderly woman's hands in white cotton sleeves offering a small white bowl-shaped cup with a thin green rim to the rain-wet hands of a traveller wrapped in a dark soaked blanket, steam rising, dark earthen room with warm firelight all around
shots.motion_prompt: Steam curls slowly upward, the hands hold still, firelight flickers, the camera is fixed

narration.am: በዝናብ የራሰ መንገደኛ ነበር። ስሙን እንኳ ሳትጠይቅ፣ ቡናውን ሰጠችው።
narration.en: It was a traveller, soaked by the rain. Without even asking his name, she gave him the coffee.

shots.reason: States what she believed, in her own words, before we lose her
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of the same grandmother from the reference, white shawl with green and gold border, seated in her dark room, head turned in three quarter view toward a small clay charcoal brazier glowing at her side, calm and content
shots.motion_prompt: Embers glow and dim, she breathes calmly, the camera drifts slowly left

narration.en: “It is people who fill a house,” she used to say.

shots.reason: Time jump: cool light and height show distance and loss
shots.image_prompt: Small modern city apartment at evening, a large window with rain and blurred city lights, the same round black clay jebena bottle with tall slender neck and small white cups with a thin green rim on a low table, cool blue light with one warm lamp, no people
shots.motion_prompt: Rain runs down the window, city lights shimmer, the camera pulls back very slowly

narration.am: ዛሬ እሷ የለችም። እኔም ከቤት ርቄ እኖራለሁ።
narration.en: Today she is gone, and I live far from home.

shots.reason: The habit survives: the grandchild repeats her gesture
shots.image_prompt: Close view of a low table in a modern room with three small white bowl-shaped cups with a thin green rim, a young adult's hand with deep brown skin and a plain dark sleeve setting down one cup apart from the others, warm lamp light, rain on the window behind
shots.motion_prompt: The hand gently sets the cup down and rests, steam rises, the camera is fixed

narration.am: ግን ቡና ሳፈላ፣ አሁንም አንድ ትርፍ ሲኒ አስቀምጣለሁ።
narration.en: But when I make coffee, I still set out one extra cup.

shots.reason: Turns to the viewer: the cup is now full and waiting for them
shots.image_prompt: One small white bowl-shaped cup like a tiny porcelain bowl, smooth round sides, thin green rim, filled with dark coffee, steam rising, on a low wooden table in a modern apartment, behind it the apartment door slightly open with warm light spilling in
shots.motion_prompt: Steam rises slowly from the cup, warm light grows through the door, the camera pushes in gently

narration.am: ምናልባት፣ መንገድ ላይ ያሉት እርስዎ ይሆናሉ።
narration.en: Perhaps the one still on the road is you.
